title: Dagupan City treasurer dismissed over P1-M 'ghost' motorboats purchase
summary: The Ombudsman has dismissed Dagupan City Treasurer Romelita Alcantara over her supposed involvement in the procurement of two “ghost” wooden motorboats amounting to almost P1 million.
